groups.title: Circle shears · value line
groups.lead: Motorized and manual circle shears with flanging — NovoTech value line, built in China.

intro_add: NovoTech's value-line circle shears, built in China, add the MCS-1250E motorized circle shear for discs to Ø49″ in 10 ga and the HCS and ECS circle shears with flanging rolls.
points_add: NovoTech value line: MCS-1250E motorized circle shear Ø8 – 49″, HCS / ECS circle shears with flanging
